sources.producer: Republic of the Union of Myanmar Constitution; FAO legal repository mirror of primary legal text
sources.exact_clause_56e: grouping Konkyan and Laukkai townships in Shan State as Kokang Self-Administered Zone
sources.finding: Section56(e) names a two-township grouping. Section54 prescribes presidential action on a Chief Minister recommendation for local boundary or name alterations. Neither provision identifies geoBoundaries feature IDs or supplies the retained2019 township coordinates.
sources.extent_scale_datum: Named administrative units; no inspected surveyed map annex or scale/datum for these footprints.
sources.limit: Constitutional Kokang grouping is supported. Equality with the retained framework parent named Laukkaing, or a particular district polygon, is not proved.

sources.missing_maps: Original1:250000 treaty sheets and applicable1:50000 detail sheets, followed by controlling protocol maps and dated survey/control information for the actual Kokang border corridor.

sources.river_rule_limit: ArticleVIII distinguishes midstream for unnavigable rivers from the main navigational channel for navigable rivers, and retains the boundary after a river course change absent another bilateral agreement. A present river channel alone cannot be assumed controlling.

lineage_assessment.supported: A primary constitutional provision groups named Konkyan and Laukkai townships as Kokang SAZ. GAD township covers and text independently place the two Burmese-named profile subjects in Kokang.
lineage_assessment.not_supported: The framework parent name Laukkaing and retained MMR ADM2 source ID are not legal identity evidence for Kokang SAZ. The census district title Laukine is a different administrative label. Complete two-child roster correspondence does not prove identical whole original footprint.
lineage_assessment.current_cuts: Copied original/current envelopes show smaller current north/east extrema; both owners have topology reconciliation notes (2 and3 conflicts). No cut is accepted based on the named legal grouping.
lineage_assessment.foreign_sid_limit: Observed families include CHN ADM1. Konkyan has additional SID15319; its exact country/owner identity is not joined from the available small inventory. No new source or spatial query performed.
